name: Xfinity Mobile
notes: Researched from public xfinity.com support articles only (no sign-in). The Xfinity Mobile bill is separate from other Xfinity services and only Primary or Manager users see billing. Automatic payment is the default and required: the card on file is charged the full balance about 20 days after the bill cycle ends; the card can be changed but automatic payment cannot be turned off, so autopay_cancel is unsupported (the 20-day timing cannot be expressed). One-time early payments are made after signing in with the Primary Xfinity ID (full balance or another amount, card on file or another card, possibly a six-digit security code); no guest payment is documented (guest_pay unsupported, inferred). Payments are by card. Repayment plans (6 or 12 payments) and a one-month deferral are set up by an agent in chat, not self-service, so payment_arrangement is unsupported online. Cancelling without porting means contacting Xfinity; porting a number out cancels that line automatically. Sign-in is an Xfinity ID (email, mobile number or username). Plans, paperless and fees are not modelled. Integrated 2026-10-09: billing.methods ['card']: no saved checking account; generated tasks use the saved Visa.

guest_pay.note: Payments are made after signing in with the Primary Xfinity ID in your Xfinity Mobile account or the Xfinity app; questions go to Xfinity Mobile at 1-888-936-4968.

autopay.note: Automatic payment is set up by default and charges the card on file.

autopay_cancel.note: Xfinity Mobile bills are always paid automatically; you can change the card on file but not turn automatic payment off. Call 1-888-936-4968 with questions.

payment_arrangement.note: Repayment plans (6 or 12 payments) and one-month deferrals are set up by an agent: chat with Xfinity Assistant or call 1-888-936-4968.

cancel_service.note: To stop service without moving your number, contact Xfinity Mobile at 1-888-936-4968 or chat. Porting your number to a new carrier cancels that line automatically.

help.title: How do I pay my Xfinity Mobile bill?
paragraphs: Xfinity Mobile bills are paid automatically by default: each month Xfinity charges your card for the full balance about 20 days after the bill cycle ends. You can also make a one-time payment before then.

To pay early online, sign in with the Primary Xfinity ID, choose the full balance or another amount, pick the card on file or a different card (you may be asked for a six-digit security code), review and submit. In the Xfinity app, use Make early payment on the Xfinity Mobile Billing card.
Missed payments can interrupt service and add a late fee. If the account has no balance due, you will see a message that no payment is needed.
steps: Sign in with the Primary Xfinity ID.
Select the card and click Continue.

help.title: Repayment plans and payment deferrals
paragraphs: If you have a past-due balance you can split it into up to 6 or 12 payments, depending on how much you owe. Only one plan is allowed at a time, the payments are charged automatically to the card on file, and you cannot add lines or buy devices while it is active.

To see if you qualify, chat with Xfinity Assistant; an agent sets up the plan and emails the dates and amounts. Plan details do not appear in the app or online account. Missing a plan payment gives you four days to pay before the plan may be cancelled.
Customers who are current can instead ask to defer their next automatic payment by up to 30 days, before that payment is due; two payments may then fall due together.

help.title: Viewing your Xfinity Mobile billing
paragraphs: Your Xfinity Mobile bill is separate from your other Xfinity services. Signed in, you see your upcoming automatic payment, details for each line, payment history, bill downloads and credits. Only Primary or Manager users can view billing.
Xfinity emails a payment reminder with your automatic payment date, a confirmation after each payment, and an alert if the card cannot be charged.

help.title: Cancel Xfinity Mobile
paragraphs: If you want to stop service and are not moving your number, contact Xfinity. If you transfer your number to a new provider, Xfinity cancels that line automatically once the transfer completes, so do not cancel first or you will lose the number.

To get the transfer (port-out) security PIN, sign in with the Primary or Manager Xfinity ID, open Devices, pick the line and choose Transfer your number, cancel this line, confirm with the one-time passcode sent to that line and have the PIN texted to you. One PIN works for every number on the account and expires after seven days.

Any remaining device payment balance is due with your final bill if you cancel all Xfinity services; with other Xfinity services you may keep paying monthly. Unlimited data charges are split by how much of the cycle has passed.
